At least three independent, editor-verified sources must share a clothing tag in the same city, scene and calendar month before a cell becomes visible. It describes this contributed panel only.
Connect the local intake server to inspect this panel.

    
Withdraw a contribution ↗
Removes the original and contribution metadata from the active local store and excludes it from every subsequent aggregate. A minimal hash tombstone prevents the same image being re-added. Copies of private backups must be removed separately by their owner.
Editorial desk ↗
The key stays in memory for this page. Review provenance, permission and source independence. Approving never publishes an image.
